Don't have an account with a Desjardins caisse or credit union?

You need to register for AccèsD before you can manage your credit card account. You can register online Register for AccèsD with a credit card number. or by phone at 1-800-224-7737 Phone number of customer service. This link opens your phone app. (1-800-CAISSES).

Lost or stolen card?

Before calling us, you can log in to AccèsD and use the Lock card feature to temporarily lock your card and prevent fraudulent transactions.

Learn more  about the Lock card feature.

Fraud protection

  • Security alerts by text message if we detect unusual activity on your credit card account
  • Zero Liability if fraudulent transactions are made with your card
  • Desjardins Identity Protection to safeguard your assets and support you if your identity is stolen

FAQ

With the phasing out of overdraft transfers, what can I do to protect my account against insufficient fund charges?

To make sure your account doesn’t have insufficient funds, activate the Insufficient funds and Minimum balance reached alerts in our mobile and online services.

Learn more about alerts

You can also get a line of credit that’s right for you. Use it to cover a payment or a withdrawal if you don’t have the funds you need in your account.

Do I need to notify you before I travel to avoid having my card locked?

No. However, if we suspect fraud, your card may still be locked while you travel. You can lower the chance of this happening by using your PIN for all your transactions abroad.

Make sure that your information is up to date in the Security section in AccèsD so that we can reach you if your card is locked.

If your card has been locked and we can't reach you, you can call us collect at 514-397-4610 Phone number to report a locked credit card. This link opens your phone app..

Sign up for voice authentication before your trip by calling us at 1-800-224-7737 Phone number for customer service. This link opens your phone app.  (1-800-CAISSES).

How do I make a payment on my Desjardins credit card?

You can make a payment on your credit card online or on the phone.

On AccèsD

  1. Log in to AccèsD.
  2. Under Cards, loans and credit or under Accounts in the Quick access section of the mobile app, select the credit card in question.
  3. When you log in using a web browser, select Pay card. If you use the app, select Pay.
  4. Follow the instructions.

By phone

Montreal area:

514-397-4415 Phone number of the card services customer service for the Montreal area. This link opens your phone app.

Elsewhere in Canada and the US:

1-800-363-3380 Phone number of the card services customer service for Canada and the US. This link opens your phone app.

How do I activate my new Desjardins credit card?

You can activate your card online or by phone in the following cases:

  • Your card was replaced and you want to make a purchase without using your PIN (online purchases, contactless payment or preauthorized payment).
  • You applied for a credit card and you want to use it for the first time.

You can activate your replacement card by using your old PIN at a payment terminal.

Online

  1. Log in to the Desjardins mobile services app or AccèsD from a web browser.
  2. On the page where your new credit card appears, select Activate card.
  3. Enter your credit card expiry date and the 3-digit CVV, then select Continue.
  4. Enter your PIN twice, then select Confirm to complete the activation process.
  5. For information on credit balance insurance, select Learn more.

By phone

Montreal area:

514-397-1580 Phone number to activate your credit card for the Montreal area. This link opens your phone app.

Elsewhere in Canada and the US:

1-888-389-7823 Phone number to activate your credit card for Canada and the US. This link opens your phone app.

How can I increase my credit limit?

If you’re the sole cardholder, you can apply to increase your credit limit on AccèsD. See how to manage your credit card limit online.

If you’re not the sole cardholder, you need to apply for a limit increase by phone at 1-800-224-7737 Phone number of the card services customer service for Canada and the US. This link opens your phone app. (1-800-CAISSES).

How can I cancel my credit card?

You can cancel your credit card if you don't want to use it anymore. However, cancelling your credit card doesn't erase:

  • The balance due
  • Any outstanding payments on an Accord D financing plan
  • Any payments left on the pay in installments option
  • Transactions authorized before the cancellation
  • Pre-authorized payment arrangements (such as memberships or bill payments)

To close your credit card account, call us at 514-397-4415 Phone number of the card services customer service for the Montreal area. This link opens your phone app. or at 1-800-363-3380 Phone number of the card services customer service for Canada and the US. This link opens your phone app.. Keep in mind that you'll have to pay off your balance in full even if you cancel your card.

How do I dispute a credit card charge?

Disputing a charge is a process that allows you to request a refund on an unauthorized transaction or on one where the terms and conditions established with the merchant weren't fulfilled. Before disputing a charge, make sure it's not a preauthorization at a gas station or a transaction that's authorized but not posted.

Follow these steps to dispute a charge:

  1. Make a good-faith effort to resolve the issue with the merchant.
  2. Contact Desjardins customer service to open your file.
  3. Wait for the dispute settlement.

Learn more about disputing a credit card charge

If you suspect a fraud, contact us immediately at 1-800-224-7737 This link opens your phone app..

Learn more about refunds in the event of fraud
